question: In India vehicles are driven on which side of the road?
explanation: Unless signs or markings say otherwise, keep the vehicle as far as possible to the left of the carriageway (Reg. 4(3)).

en.question: In India vehicles are driven on which side of the road?
en.explanation: Unless signs or markings say otherwise, keep the vehicle as far as possible to the left of the carriageway (Reg. 4(3)).

question: At a roundabout you should give way to:
explanation: While entering a roundabout, traffic already in the roundabout has the right of way (Reg. 10(1)).

आपके बाद प्रवेश करने वाले को

question: You are on a minor road joining a main road. You should:
options: Give way to traffic on the main road
Expect the main road to give way
explanation: A vehicle exiting a minor road onto a major road does not get the right-of-way priority; give way to traffic on the major road (Reg. 9(2)).

question: On a narrow hill road, the vehicle going downhill should give way to the vehicle going uphill.
explanation: On narrow mountain or steep roads the downhill driver must stop on the left side and let the uphill vehicle pass first (Reg. 21(1)).

question: You may enter a junction even if your exit is blocked and you would obstruct cross traffic.
explanation: Slow down at every intersection and do not enter if you could endanger others, or if the intersection has come to a standstill, even with a signal to proceed (Reg. 9).

question: At an intersection with no signs or signals, which vehicle generally has the right of way?
options: The vehicle approaching from your right
The vehicle approaching from your left
explanation: Vehicles approaching from the right generally have the right of way, except where signals, manual control or mandatory signs apply, or when exiting a minor road onto a major one (Reg. 9(2)).
